dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey there, why are you sighing alone at this cavern entrance?

dialogues.speaker: Captain Night Raven
dialogues.text: Well, I've been living here lately...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You've been living in a place like this!?

dialogues.speaker: Captain Night Raven
dialogues.text: I didn't have a choice! A bunch of actors came to the island and started making a racket all day and all night. I couldn't even sleep because of them... So I found myself a quieter spot.

dialogues.speaker: Captain Night Raven
dialogues.text: But then a group of hilichurls came out of nowhere and occupied my resting place. So I had no choice but to brave the elements out here!

dialogues.speaker: Captain Night Raven
dialogues.text: *sigh* I swore to myself that if someone could help me, I'd tell them...

dialogues.speaker: Captain Night Raven
dialogues.text: Tell them about a clue to finding the legendary Secret Pirate Treasure! Although I only know a quarter of it...

dialogues.speaker: Captain Night Raven
dialogues.text: You seem like you're here for the treasure too. So, what do you say? Get rid of the hilichurls in there and I'll give you the clue's location.

dialogues.speaker: Captain Night Raven
dialogues.text: They say that if you collect all four parts of the clue, you can find the treasure that pirates left behind here!
